    Basic data of a basic algebra #

    Over an algebraically closed field, if every simple module has the dimension of its endomorphism ring (the basic condition), then every simple module is one-dimensional, A / J is commutative, the Wedderburn blocks are 1 × 1, and lifting the block idempotents gives BasicData with R = J (exists_basicData).

    source

    Module.finrank k (S →ₗ[A] S) = 1
